The following events took place in '''16,700 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[First Alsakan Conflict]] is ended by the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]], which uses its control of the [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace beacon]] system used by both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] to force a peace between the two sides by threatening to withhold access.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
